transcript.content: Hello, welcome in. What brings you in to see me today?

Well, I'm here because... I'm pretty sure the people on my environmental modeling contract have been tracking my revisions. They're planting errors in the datasets to make it look like I can't lead the work anymore. My wife keeps telling me it's just, you know, version-control mistakes, and the junior analysts say the same thing, but... I know what I'm seeing.
Aside from noticing these issues in the data, have you been hearing any voices, sounds, or messages that other people don't seem to hear?
No, I haven't heard any voices or anything like that. It's really just the data... the numbers themselves. I don't hear anything out of the ordinary, I just see what they're doing to the models.
How has your mood been lately, aside from the stress this situation has caused?

My mood is fine, really. I mean, aside from being frustrated about what they're doing at work, I feel pretty normal. I'm not feeling down or... or upset about anything else in my life. It's just the stress of having to constantly catch and fix those errors they keep slipping into the datasets. But my mood itself is fine.
